content.title: Small Banks Primed for Big Gains on Curve Steepening
content.summary: The S&P Regional Bank Select Index, home to lenders like Pathward Financial Inc. and Metropolitan Bank Holding Corp., is on track to outperform the S&P 500 Index for a third consecutive month, the longest winning streak since 2022.  The US economy is humming along, reducing the relative appeal of bigger lenders with sturdier balance sheets, say strategists at 22V Research, who are overweight small-cap banks.
